command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'HOST='; hostname
printf 'USER='; whoami
find "$HOME" -maxdepth 4 -type d -name .git -print 2>/dev/null | while read -r g; do d=${g%/.git}; u=$(git -C "$d" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true); case "$u" in *gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git*|*gschaidergabriel/frankenstein*) printf 'FRANKENSTEIN_CHECKOUT=%s
ORIGIN=%s
HEAD=%s
BRANCH=%s
' "$d" "$u" "$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)" "$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true)";; esac; done
